span.p: The panel: 64-bit ARM SoM plus carrier

span.p:
SoC
quad-core ARM64, 2 GB RAM
a DRM/KMS display device; no GPU needed, no compositor

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
eMMC or SD
2 GB free after the OS
holds up to 5 releases

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Display
its real geometry is read from DRM on connect
touch optional

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ethernet or Wi-Fi
SSH is the only channel the Studio uses

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
/dev/gpiochipN
digital in and out via libgpiod

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
/dev/ttyN
serial via pyserial, Modbus TCP over the network

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Windows or Linux
no special hardware
network route to the panel
